title: India's Modi government calls special sitting of parliament
summary: The sitting of the Indian parliament comes after its monsoon session was adjourned sine die in August. Follow DW.

image.caption: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju and the communications from the two houses do not elaborate why Modi's government has called the sittingImage: AP/picture alliance

blocks.text: The sitting of the Indian parliament comes after its monsoon session was adjourned sine die in August. Follow DW.

blocks.caption: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju and the communications from the two houses do not elaborate why Modi's government has called the sittingImage: AP/picture alliance

blocks.text: These are our rolling updates from India on Friday, November 27:

items: A brief sitting of the Indian parliament will take place after the monsoon session was adjourned indefinitely back in August
India's Lok Sabha is set to meet on Monday
The Rajya Sabha will resume proceedings on Wednesday

blocks.text: How has india's opposition reacted to the reconvening of parliament?

India's main opposition Congress party has deemed the move by Modi's government to call for the brief sitting of the parliament "an assault on the Constitution of India" which Congress General Secretary in-charge Communications and MP Jairam Ramesh said "must and will be resisted with all might."
In a post on X, Ramesh accused the government of "moving to manufacture a fraudulent two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha"
Ramesh also listed out a three-point Congress stance on delimitation and women's quota, which includes:

items: Maintaining the current strength of the Lok Sabha for another 25 years.
⁠Maintaining the current state-wise distribution of seats in the Lok Sabha for another 25 years
Implementation of one-third reservation for women and reservation within reservation for women belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes from the next general elections, slated for 2029.

blocks.text: A meeting of the Congress Parliamentary Strategy Group is also expected to be held on Saturday to discuss the gameplan for the upcoming parliament sitting, news agency ANI reported.
